video_title: LeBron James Talks Wemby, Playoffs, and His Future in the NBA | MIND THE GAME

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the 2007 Cavaliers' loss to the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: We were not outworked, they didn't out-physical us, they didn't out-smart us, we were out-talented.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: We played to the maximum ability of our team. We were not outworked, they didn't out-physical us, they didn't out-smart us, we were out-talented.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Victor Wembanyama's unique coordination
quotes.excerpt: His ability to catch the ball with his back towards the basket is coordination we've never seen.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: His ability to catch the ball with his back towards the basket or half of his body and be able to find the rim before he even lands, that is coordination that we've never seen before and it's not just because he's tall.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the success of his injury-free off-season
quotes.excerpt: An off-season without rehab is a success after a long season, so I'll take it.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I think we both can agree that an off-season without rehab is a success after a long season, so I'll take it.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the talent disparity against the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: We played to the maximum ability of our team, but ultimately, we were out-talented by OKC.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: We played to the maximum ability of our team, but ultimately, if we're being completely honest, we were out-talented by OKC. They just possessed so much more talent than us.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the Thunder's development and talent acquisition
quotes.excerpt: People forget what OKC looked like five years ago. They add that talent around them.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: People forget what OKC looked like five years ago, what they looked like four years ago. They add that talent around them, they get even younger, they add some more experience with Harrison Barnes and De'Aaron Fox, who have playoff experience, Luke Kornet, who has playoff experience. They add those pieces to that young group and now you see what happens.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his free agency and future in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I'm still in the moment of just taking my time. I haven't even really thought about it.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I'm still in the moment of just taking my time and saying I haven't even really thought about it too much. Obviously, I understand that I'm a free agent and I can control my own destiny.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the Knicks' identity and playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: We know what we're going to get out of the Knicks. They're going to play hard.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: We know what we're going to get out of the Knicks. They're going to play hard, they're going to play tough. They have their guys, they know their roles. They know exactly what they need to do every game. It doesn't always result in a win, but at least they know what their staple is. You know, it looks a little bit different from game to game, but it starts with Jalen Brunson, OG Anunoby has played great ball, Mitchell Robinson started to get it going later in that series against Philly, Josh Hart playing great, the bench is playing great, and obviously Josh Hart is kind of one of those Swiss Army knives who does everything.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the importance of respecting Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: If you don't treat him with the same level of respect that you treat Giannis with.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: If you don't treat him with the same level of respect that you treat Giannis Antetokounmpo with, when Giannis gets a rebound, everyone talks about get back and load to Giannis. Get back, set the defense and load, because if not, he's punching gaps right away and he's on the rim right away.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the difficulty of guarding Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: He's another level. Nobody's at the level of Victor Wembanyama so far defensively.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Wembanyama is another level. Nobody's at the level of Victor Wembanyama so far defensively. He can do it all and he can also guard on the switch. If you ask him to switch, he can guard a guard on a switch throughout the course of a game too. He's just unbelievable.
